dismissals.because: src/forge/init.py:69 Forge writes forge.toml itself with an unindented, unquoted version = line (and the agent edits it the same way); indented or quoted-key pins are not a supported form

findings.body: The regex misses valid TOML pins with indentation or quoted keys, such as `  version = "v0.0.1"`. Those configurations reach `repo.check_pin`, which validates the entire configuration first (`src/forge/repo.py:257` and `167–179`). With the test's incompatible `repo` value, this produces a configuration error instead of the required version refusal; otherwise it recommends installing the old version rather than upgrading the destination pin. Multiline version strings also enter the exception handler, whose unconditional return silently abandons approval even when `check_pin` succeeds. Extract the actual top-level version value before full validation, and continue approval when it matches.
findings.title: Not done: 4. Read the story repo's pin before validating its configuration
